method: OpenAlex title_and_abstract.search with strict AND boolean across 3 keyword unions
queries: title_and_abstract.search:"ultrahigh resolution mass" AND "dissolved organic matter"
caveats: OpenAlex title/abstract coverage varies by publisher and era; pre-2010 counts may be undercounted because abstract metadata is patchier.
Counts include reviews and primary research; not separated.
Synonyms 'FT-ICR-MS' (hyphenated) vs 'FTICR' (no hyphen) vs 'ultrahigh-resolution MS' partly overlap; deduplication is by OpenAlex work-id.
Web of Science / Scopus strict-topic queries would likely give a similar shape with slightly lower absolute numbers.
